text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Monday.
- President Tudjman nominated as the Croatian Democratic Union (HDZ) presidential candidate at the elections to be held later this year.
- Some 51,110 workers on sick leave in Croatia every day.
- The securities commission calls for the founding of a central depositary agency.
- The 0800 freephone numbers introduced in Croatia. The line itself costs 500 kuna and the monthly fee is 400 kuna.
- Croatia seeks 100 million German marks from the World Bank to back up a general privatisation of its economy.
- Unemployment: Lawyers and economists face the largest problems when seeking work in Zagreb. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
